privacy: Who we are
EchoTake is a music-practice app provided by Prizm. This policy covers the app and this policy page. Contact: prizm_kr@hotmail.com.
Practice data stays local

Imported audio and video, microphone recordings, lesson names, saved phrases, playback settings, waveforms and preferences are processed and stored on your device. EchoTake has no account system or developer-operated media server. We do not automatically upload your practice content, sell personal data, display ads or include third-party analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDKs. Apple may separately provide diagnostics according to your device sharing settings.
Microphone and file access

Microphone permission is requested when you enable recording. Recording happens only during an explicitly started foreground session, with a visible indicator, and stops on interruption, inactivity or screen lock. Denying access leaves non-recording modes available. The system Photos picker provides only selected media; the app does not require broad photo-library or camera access. Files providers may download a cloud-only file that you choose.
Purchases and network exceptions

Apple processes purchases and restoration through StoreKit. The app verifies transaction information and stores a purchase-status cache on the device; it does not receive payment-card details. EchoTake does not use RevenueCat. Apple, chosen cloud-file providers and destinations you select for exports process information under their own policies. Apple privacy information: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/ .
Retention, deletion and backup

Delete lessons and takes using app controls. Unkept temporary recordings are automatically pruned, with limits of five completed temporary takes and 200 MB, subject to active-file protection. Explicitly kept takes and imported originals are excluded from that cleanup. App removal normally removes the local app container, but exported copies, device backups and cloud-provider copies may remain. Manage those with the relevant provider. A manual library backup includes originals, phrases, settings and kept takes; it excludes temporary takes, rebuildable caches and purchase entitlements. Purchase restoration does not restore media files. Operating-system device backups may also include app data under your settings.
Optional support and diagnostics

Diagnostics are exported only when you request them. The report contains settings, entitlement state and storage totals, without lesson filenames, titles or media. If you email support, we receive your address, message and anything you attach. We use that information to handle the request and retain it as needed for support or legal obligations. Request access, correction or deletion by email; applicable legal rights remain available. We cannot retrieve or remotely delete practice files stored only on your device.
This website and international services

This page is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may process technical request data, including IP addresses, under https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement . This page adds no analytics, advertising trackers or external fonts. Apple, GitHub, email and selected cloud providers may process information in other countries under their policies. This differs from the app’s local practice workflow.
Children and your choices

EchoTake is designed for music learners, primarily adults. We do not knowingly request children’s personal information or provide public profiles or in-app social sharing. Children should use recording, purchases and external sharing with appropriate guardian involvement. You can revoke microphone access in system settings, use non-recording modes and choose what to export. Contact us about information submitted by a child.
Changes and contact

We will publish policy changes here and update the date. Where applicable law requires additional notice or consent, we will provide it. For privacy questions or rights requests, email prizm_kr@hotmail.com.

What EchoTake provides

EchoTake supports practice with compatible local lesson audio and video: A–B phrases, playback adjustment, video zoom, automatic audio recording and sequential comparison. It does not provide music rights, streaming downloads, DRM removal, camera recording, pitch correction or performance scores. Practice is foreground-only. File, storage, device and audio-route limitations apply; compatibility with every format or Bluetooth device is not promised.
Free use and Lifetime

The free tier includes two imported lessons, two saved phrases per lesson and 1–3-round Lesson Mirror sessions, plus basic playback, audio transposition, video zoom, original take export and library backup. Bundled samples do not count toward lesson limits. Optional EchoTake Lifetime removes commercial lesson/phrase count limits and adds up to 20 rounds, step training, phrase sequences and processed export of user audio. Technical and storage limits still apply.
Purchases, restoration and refunds

Lifetime is a non-consumable, one-time purchase, not a subscription, with no automatic renewal. The App Store shows the local price before purchase. Restore a valid purchase using the same Apple Account through the app; availability is subject to Apple’s rules, purchase status and device compatibility. Apple handles payments and refund requests under its policies; statutory rights remain unaffected. Refunded or revoked transactions may remove paid access without deleting your media. Lifetime does not promise perpetual development, operating-system support or service availability.
Your content and recording responsibility

You retain your rights in your content; import does not transfer ownership of third-party works. Import, record, modify and share only content you have permission or another legal right to use. Obtain any consent required to record other people. You are responsible for exported files and selected sharing destinations. The app does not grant rights to redistribute lesson recordings or bundled materials beyond their applicable licenses.
Storage and safe use

Keep important takes and export backups. Unkept temporary takes are automatically cleaned up, with limits of five completed takes and 200 MB, subject to active-file protection. Explicitly kept takes and imported originals are excluded. Purchase restoration cannot recover files. Device loss, deletion, uninstalling or insufficient storage may cause data loss. Use reasonable listening levels. Do not unlawfully infringe rights, compromise the app or bypass paid access; any reverse-engineering restriction applies only to the extent allowed by law.
Availability, liability and law

EchoTake is provided as available, without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation or learning results. Warranties and liability are limited only to the extent permitted by law; no term excludes non-excludable rights or liability. South Korean law governs subject to mandatory protections of your country of residence. Courts competent under applicable law retain jurisdiction. Prizm owns the app’s software and branding; your content rights remain yours.
Changes, ending use and contact

You may stop using or uninstall the app at any time. We may update these terms here, change the displayed date and provide additional notice or consent where required by law. Changes do not remove accrued statutory rights. Privacy practices are explained in the linked Privacy Policy. For support or questions, email prizm_kr@hotmail.com.

練習データは端末内で処理

保存・削除・バックアップ

アプリ内でレッスンやテイクを削除できます。未保存の一時録音は完了済み5件・200MBを上限に自動整理しますが、使用中のファイルは保護します。明示的に保存したテイクと読み込んだ原本は対象外です。アンインストールでは通常アプリ内データが削除されますが、書き出したファイル、端末バックアップ、クラウドのコピーは残る場合があり、各サービスで管理してください。手動バックアップには原本・区間・設定・保存したテイクを含み、一時録音・再生成可能なキャッシュ・購入権限を除きます。購入の復元では教材は戻りません。OSの端末バックアップにも設定によりアプリデータが含まれる場合があります。
任意のサポートと診断
